items.source: When this flag is set to true messages within the same session will be sent to the "clientInboundChannel" one at a time to preserve the order in which they were received.
items.translation: 当此标志设置为 `true` 时，同一会话中的消息将按接收顺序依次发送到 `"clientInboundChannel"`。

items.source: By default messages sent to the "clientInboundChannel" may not be handled in the same order because the channel is backed by a ThreadPoolExecutor that in turn does not guarantee processing in order.
items.translation: 默认情况下，发送到 `"clientInboundChannel"` 的消息可能不会按相同顺序处理，因为该通道由 `ThreadPoolExecutor` 支持，而后者不保证按顺序处理。

items.source:
This handler supports assembling large STOMP messages split into multiple
WebSocket messages and STOMP clients (like stomp.js) indeed split large STOMP
messages at 16K boundaries. Therefore the WebSocket server input message
buffer size must allow 16K at least plus a little extra for SockJS framing.
items.translation: 此处理器支持将由多个 WebSocket 消息拆分的大型 STOMP 消息进行组装，而 STOMP 客户端（如 stomp.js）确实会在 16K 边界处拆分大型 STOMP 消息。因此，WebSocket 服务器输入消息缓冲区的大小必须至少允许 16K，并额外预留一些空间用于 SockJS 封装。
